user.title: Cove (Alula) Alarm
user.description: Sign in with your Cove credentials. Use your Cove email address or account number (e.g. C123456) as the username. Choose how the arm/disarm PIN is handled; a stored PIN lets automations arm/disarm unattended.

data_description.pin: Only used when PIN handling is "Store a PIN". Leave blank for the other modes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cove/Alula service.
error.pin_required: A PIN is required when PIN handling is set to "Store a PIN".

init.title: Cove (Alula) options
init.description: Change how arm/disarm is handled and tune how often Home Assistant polls the cloud. Changes apply immediately (the integration reloads).

data_description.pin: Only used when PIN handling is "Store a PIN". Leave blank for the other modes.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the cloud as a backstop. Live updates still arrive instantly over the websocket; lower only if you need faster recovery after a missed push.
data_description.availability_grace: How long to keep the last known state through a brief connection lapse before reporting entities unavailable. Higher avoids flapping; lower surfaces real outages sooner.
data_description.arm_silent: When on, arming and disarming this panel (its Home/Away/Night/Disarm buttons) are sent silently — no exit/entry beeps. The "Silent arming" switch can override this per-session.
data_description.arm_no_entry_delay: When on, arming skips the entry delay. The "No entry delay" switch can override this per-session.

error.pin_required: A PIN is required when PIN handling is set to "Store a PIN".

options.prompt: Ask for the PIN each time (nothing stored)
